title: The steep path
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: The gravel path down to the ocean. The dog can't. Wood stands at the top with him for a whole strip.

panels.composition: The top of the steep gravel path down to the beach. October. WOOD with BARNABY on the ground beside him, on his own feet. The dog looking down the path. Not moving.

characters.pose: looking down the path, not moving

image.prompt: a man and a very old dog standing at the top of a steep gravel path that drops to a gray beach, October, the dog looking down and not moving, quiet ink with a desaturated wash, no words

panels.composition: The dog's front paws at the edge of the first step. Trembling, slightly. Drawn honestly.

image.prompt: close-up of an old dog's front paws at the edge of a gravel step, trembling slightly, honest and tender, no words

panels.composition: Wood crouching. Not lifting him. Just crouching beside him, looking down the path too.

characters.pose: crouched beside the dog, looking down

image.prompt: a man crouched beside an old dog at the top of a path, both looking down at the beach, no words

panels.composition: The two of them at the top. The beach below, empty, the surf a white line. They don't go down. The strip stays at the top with them.

image.prompt: a wide quiet panel of a man and an old dog at the top of a steep path above an empty gray beach with a white line of surf, not descending, desaturated wash, no words
image.notes: Arc 4 opens. They don't go down. Nothing is said.

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: Arc 4 begins. The path he can't make.
